create_dataset_altogether_ft: create an Altogether_FT IterableDataset for finetuning with image-text pairs from a JSON data file
pad_tokens_function: pad token sequences to a fixed max length and return tokens with an attention mask
get_item_altogether_ft: retrieve a single training sample with image, tokens, attention mask, target mask, and response text
iterate_altogether_ft: iterate over the Altogether_FT dataset with distributed worker-aware sharding across ranks
transform_image_altogether_ft: apply Resize, RGB conversion, and PIL-to-tensor transforms to images for model input
